The '''University of Cadomai''' was an institution of higher learning on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cadomai Prime/Legends|Cadomai Prime]], active during the era of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. In [[3963 BBY]], swindler [[Marn Hierogryph]] claimed to be a professor of law from the University of Cadomai as part of a scheme.
